page_title: CEL 3-4 ALA | Celta Vigo v Alaves 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
90+7' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+5' Jon Guridi (Alaves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Miguel Sesma blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Celta Vigo, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
90+4' Quique Sanchez Flores is forced to make a change. Toni Martinez (Alaves) is unable to continue due to injury, Ville Koski comes on.
90+4' Denis Suarez (Alaves) will miss the next game.
90+4' What was Denis Suarez (Alaves) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
90+1' Miguel Sesma has a clear sight and sees a foul from Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo).
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes.
85' Toni Martinez (Alaves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
84' Toni Martinez (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' 53:47 – the latest ball possession ratio.
82' It is time for a substitution. Iago Aspas is on for Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo).
81' That was close. Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
80' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' The attendance for today's match is 20260.

78' 3 - 4 An amazing individual effort from Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 3:4. Ionut Radu was helpless.
77' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
74' 3 - 3 Toni Martinez (Alaves) receives a quality pass, makes a yard for himself and smashes a jaw-dropping long-range shot into the bottom left corner. What a remarkable goal!
73' Jon Guridi (Alaves) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
71' Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
69' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Borja Iglesias is replaced by Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo).
69' That will be all from Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pablo Duran.

66' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
65' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Sesma had an easy-decision to make.
64' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.
64' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Antonio Sivera, who smothers the ball. Celta Vigo force a corner. They send men into the box.
63' Jonny Otto (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Miguel Sesma blows for a foul.
62' Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
60' Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Angel Perez (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.
58' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Celta Vigo players look gutted.
57' Wait! Referee Miguel Sesma has indicated he is going to review the Celta Vigo goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
56' Goal! Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 4:2.
54' The referee allows time for a substitution. Oscar Mingueza will be replaced by Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo).
54' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Alvaro Nunez and he is replaced by Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo).
52' Jon Guridi (Alaves) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
50' 3 - 2 Goal - 3:2! Angel Perez (Alaves) receives a precise pass inside the box from Toni Martinez and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
49' Toni Martinez (Alaves) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
48' Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
46' Quique Sanchez Flores makes a half-time substitution. Ibrahim Diabate comes on in place of Lucas Boye (Alaves).
46' Quique Sanchez Flores has made a change at the break. Denis Suarez has come on in place of Carles Alena (Alaves).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jon Pacheco (Alaves) is replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Quique Sanchez Flores probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Pablo Ibanez (Alaves). He is replaced by Jon Guridi.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Miguel Sesma shows a yellow card to Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) for his blatant foul.
45+3' 3 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Angel Perez plays it into the box, and Toni Martinez (Alaves) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 3:1.
45+2' Miguel Sesma couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) and blew his whistle.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' Alvaro Nunez (Celta Vigo) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
40' Miguel Sesma blows for a foul after Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
37' 3 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
35' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Ionut Radu blocks Toni Martinez (Alaves)'s effort from the edge of the box.
30' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

27' 2 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) and Ferran Jutgla gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the right side of the goal. 2:0.
26' Jonny Otto (Alaves) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
24' Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) was too forceful with his tackle and Miguel Sesma interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
22' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jon Pacheco (Alaves) was quite harsh and Miguel Sesma didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
19' 1 - 0 Goal Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo)! Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) was put through by Javier Rodriguez and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top left corner. 1:0.
16' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

16' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Corner kick. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity.
14' The game is interrupted. Carles Alena (Alaves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
12' 45:55 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
10' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Toni Martinez (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Miguel Sesma no option but to blow his whistle.
7' Superb ball control by Toni Martinez (Alaves) after receiving an inch-perfect cross inside the box, but he unleashes a poor shot which goes well wide of the right post.
6' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
6' Alaves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
4' Rough tackle by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Miguel Sesma saw the whole situation.
1' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Celta Vigo will kick-off.
Miguel Sesma was nominated as the referee for this game.
